text: ものほしそうに　みんなよ

patterns.name: 〜な (prohibition)
patterns.explanation: な after a plain verb is a rough 'don't'; みるな is slurred to みんな in rough speech. みんなよ = 'don't look, okay'.

patterns.name: 〜そうに
patterns.explanation: そうに means 'in a way that looks like' that feeling. ものほしそうに = 'looking as if you want it'.
